programs.title: America The Beautiful: Wild Frontier
programs.desc: An episode devoted to the three great rivers of North America - the Mississippi, Missouri and Ohio.Their combination with other local rivers creates a huge mass of water that divides the United States in two.Due to harsh winters, animals living in riverine areas had to learn how to cope with these difficult conditions.Among them there are otters hunting among ice floes, bald eagles - the symbol of the USA - and stately and predatory lynxes.Thousands of seasonally migrating snow geese also fly to the river.The arrival of winter forces many animal species to make numerous preparations.

programs.title: Animal Fight Club 5
programs.desc: Another installment of a fascinating series showing the fiercest clashes in the animal world.We will see extraordinary weapons and incredible tactics used by participants in the fierce fight for survival.The program presents recordings of the most powerful predators, such as lions, crocodiles and sharks, and tiny but surprisingly tough creatures, such as grasshoppers and brave insects.From the plains of Africa to the snowy wastes of North America, these are battlefields for territory, dominance and females.Thanks to elements of computer graphics, scenes presented in slow motion, close-ups and replays of key moments, viewers will not miss any detail.

programs.title: Weather Gone Viral: Season 8
programs.desc: Dangerous weather phenomena recorded in various parts of the world will be presented.Dramatic, sometimes unbelievable witness recordings prove how unpredictable nature can be.

programs.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol 10 Compilation
programs.desc: A reminder of the greatest moments and critical situations.The vet and his team meet unusual patients, deal with complicated cases, and experience touching moments.
